9	// A read-view operation reruns every Git command it captured when it ends, to prove the
10	// output did not change while the operation ran. Some commands cannot change: their output is
11	// a pure function of object ids, or of the commit HEAD named when they ran. For those the
12	// rerun proves nothing the commit does not already prove, and it is the dearest part of a
13	// check (spec pose-governance-audit-skips-pure-git-reads).
14	
15	var governanceFullObjectID = regexp.MustCompile(`^[0-9a-f]{40}$`)
16	
17	// governancePureGitRead classifies a captured command. byObject means the output depends on
18	// object ids alone; byHead means it depends on the commit HEAD named when it ran, which the
19	// capture reads before and after the command. Anything not listed exactly is neither, and
20	// keeps its rerun: a ref name, --all, a pretty format that names refs, or a flag the
21	// classification does not know can all make the output depend on mutable state.
22	func governancePureGitRead(args []string) (byObject, byHead bool) {
23		if len(args) == 0 {
24			return false, false
25		}
26		switch args[0] {
27		case "show":
28			// show <40-hex>:<path>
29			if len(args) == 2 {
30				id, path, ok := strings.Cut(args[1], ":")
31				return ok && governanceFullObjectID.MatchString(id) && path != "", false
32			}
33		case "cat-file":
34			// cat-file blob <40-hex>
35			return len(args) == 3 && args[1] == "blob" && governanceFullObjectID.MatchString(args[2]), false
36		case "log":
37			// log -1 --format=%H -- <path...>: the last commit that changed the paths, from HEAD.
38			if len(args) >= 5 && args[1] == "-1" && args[2] == "--format=%H" && args[3] == "--" {
39				return false, true
40			}
41		case "ls-tree":
42			// ls-tree [flags] <40-hex> [-- <path...>]
43			i := 1
44			for i < len(args) && strings.HasPrefix(args[i], "-") && args[i] != "--" {
45				switch args[i] {
46				case "-z", "-r", "-t", "-l", "--name-only", "--full-tree":
47				default:
48					return false, false
49				}
50				i++
51			}
52			if i >= len(args) {
53				return false, false
54			}
55			tree := args[i]
56			i++
57			if i < len(args) && args[i] != "--" {
58				return false, false
59			}
60			// ls-tree HEAD is cheap to rerun and dearer to qualify (two HEAD reads): it keeps its rerun.
61			return governanceFullObjectID.MatchString(tree), false
62		}
63		return false, false
64	}
65	
66	// governanceAuditGit runs a captured command again for the final audit; tests replace it to
67	// count the reruns.
68	var governanceAuditGit = runGovernanceGitCommandOutputContext
69	
70	// governanceHeadAt reads HEAD of a root directly, outside any read view, so that no
71	// observation is recorded and the answer is the repository's now.
72	func governanceHeadAt(ctx context.Context, files Files, root string) string {
73		stdout, _, err := runGovernanceGitCommandOutputContext(ctx, files, root, []string{"rev-parse", "--verify", "HEAD"}, 4096)
74		if err != nil {
75			return ""
76		}
77		return strings.TrimSpace(string(stdout))
78	}

78	## 5. Decisions
79	
80	### Decision D1
81	- Basis: R1, R2, R3
82	- Minimal option: manter a auditoria reexecutando tudo
83	- Selected option: pular a reexecução do que é função pura de ids de objeto, e do que é função pura do commit do HEAD enquanto o HEAD de agora é o mesmo de quando rodou
84	- Rationale: um objeto do Git não muda sob o seu id, e a saída de um `log -1 -- path` a partir de um commit é função do grafo abaixo dele; a reexecução só poderia divergir se o HEAD tivesse se movido, e isso é verificado por uma leitura do HEAD por raiz
85	- Consequences: o HEAD é lido duas vezes por leitura de histórico na captura (cerca de 4 ms contra 57 ms economizados) e uma vez por raiz na auditoria; um repositório que ganha histórico por `git fetch --deepen` durante a operação não é visto por essas leituras
86	- Falsifier: uma auditoria que deixa de apontar uma mudança que a reexecução apontaria, ou uma saída de `review-check` que difere
87	
88	## 6. Validation
89	
90	### Strategy
91	
92	Um teste classifica os formatos aceitos e recusados; outro conta as reexecuções com um repositório real (nada muda: as puras não são reexecutadas e as demais são; o HEAD se move: a de histórico é reexecutada e a mudança é apontada). O teste de contagem falha quando a classificação é desligada (verificado).
93	
94	### Deterministic checks
95	
96	`go test` dos testes do rastreio e a matriz estrita em clone limpo; a comparação byte a byte da saída e o tempo foram medidos no `pose-dist`.

99	- R1 [satisfied] test:TestOnlyReadsThatCannotDependOnMutableStateAreClassifiedPure check:audit-pure-git-integration
100	- R2 [satisfied] test:TestTheFinalAuditSkipsPureReadsWhileTheirCommitStandsAndOnlyThen
101	- R3 [satisfied] test:TestTheFinalAuditSkipsPureReadsWhileTheirCommitStandsAndOnlyThen
102	- R4 [satisfied] test:TestTheFinalAuditSkipsPureReadsWhileTheirCommitStandsAndOnlyThen
103	
104	### Known gaps
105	- R4 é uma medição feita à mão (52,3 s para 25,0 s no `review-check`, com o binário anterior e o novo no mesmo repositório, e saída sem diferença), não um teste de regressão; a carga da máquina entra nesses números.
106	- Um `git fetch --deepen` durante a operação muda o resultado de um `log -1 -- path` sem mover o HEAD; a auditoria não o vê para essas leituras.
107

110	## 7. Final Report
111	
112	### Delivered scope
113	As formas puras do Git são classificadas e marcadas na captura, e a auditoria final as pula enquanto o commit que as determinou se mantém (R1-R3); o `review-check` deste repositório passou de cerca de 52 s para cerca de 25 s com a saída idêntica (R4).
114	
115	### Files and modules changed
116	- pose-mcp/internal/pose: governance_git_pure.go e governance_read_view_git.go, mais os testes; a matriz ganha `audit-pure-git-integration`.
117

119	- Command: `pose validate --strict --jobs 4` em clone limpo do head revisado
120	- Result: registrado pela evidência de validação selada; revisão delegada independente concluída com `pose review conclude`.
121	
122	### Residual risks
123	- O aprofundamento de um clone raso durante a operação (ver Known gaps).
124	- A classificação é uma lista de formas exatas: uma forma nova de leitura do Git mantém a reexecução até ser classificada.

## Review of `pose-governance-audit-skips-pure-git-reads`

**What I checked.** I read the full diff of `governance_git_pure.go`, `governance_read_view_git.go` and the tests. I read the Git runner (`gitCommandContext`) and every caller of the classified forms. I ran `pose artifact-check --strict`: it exited 0, and all 928 of its findings are old "orphan" warnings on files outside this change. The other plan tools were refused by this run's profile:

- **Not run:** both `pose validate --strict` commands, `pose assess design --json` and `pose assess integrate`.
- **Not tried:** `assess discover`, `assess tech-debt` and `suggest review`. I expected the same refusal.

For the validate results I rely on the sealed evidence instead.

**Soundness (the implementer's main question).**
- **Classification is exact** (`governance_git_pure.go:22-64`):
  - Only a 40-character lowercase hex id passes. `HEAD`, ref names and SHA-256 ids are rejected, so those reads still rerun.
  - `log` must match `-1 --format=%H --` in those exact positions, so `--all`, `%d` and any other format are rejected.
  - `ls-tree` accepts only the six listed flags, and anything after the tree id other than `--` rejects it.
  - If a ref happens to be named like a 40-character id, Git warns on stderr. A read with stderr is never marked pure (`governance_read_view_git.go:347`).
- **The "pure by object id" claim holds:**
  - Every governance Git call already runs with `--no-replace-objects`, `GIT_NO_REPLACE_OBJECTS=1` and `GIT_GRAFT_FILE=/dev/null` (`git_snapshot_integrity.go:571-579`, `governance_read_view_git.go:572`). Replace refs and graft files can't change these outputs.
  - `git show <blob>` only applies textconv when it is asked for on the command line, so the output is the raw object.
- **Head-relative reads are handled safely:**
  - HEAD is read before and after the command, and the read is marked pure only if both match (`:331-353`).
  - If a HEAD read fails, it returns `""`, so the command is not marked pure. In the audit, a failed read means a rerun.
  - The audit reads HEAD once per root (`:440-453`).
- **Unchanged parts:** `identityDigest`, the observation key and the capture byte accounting are not touched. Skipped reads also don't use up the audit's byte budget. That can only turn an "unknown" result into a real audit, never the reverse.
- **Concurrency:** the two extra HEAD reads run under `state.mu`, which was already held while the command ran. Nothing new is serialized.

**Defects found (all low):**
- **F1, low** (`pose-mcp/internal/pose/governance_git_pure.go:36-40`): the spec lists only `git fetch --deepen` as a remaining gap, but there is more. The output of `log -1 --format=%H -- <path>` also depends on mutable repository config.
  - Example: with `log.showSignature=true`, Git prints signature-check text to stdout even with `--format=%H`, and that text depends on the GPG keyring.
  - The old rerun would catch such a change during the operation; the skip does not.
  - Suggested fix: pass `--no-show-signature` (or force the setting off with `-c`) on the classified form, or name the config dependence in the spec's Known gaps.
- **F2, low** (`pose-mcp/internal/pose/governance_read_view_git.go:351`): no test covers HEAD moving *during* the captured `log` command, the branch that must leave the read unmarked. The audit test also doesn't show that a `cat-file blob <id>` or `ls-tree <id>` read is actually skipped; only the classification test covers those forms.

**Already stated by the spec, not new findings:** R4 (identical output, ~52 s → ~25 s) was measured by hand and has no regression test. Deepening a shallow clone during the operation is not detected.
